Legend
  • Same result: BBS R CMD check and R Universe R CMD check (the shaded columns) agree. NOTE is treated as OK; WARNING(S) are treated the same.
  • Buttons above the table: WARNING counts as OK and TIMEOUT and skipped count as ERROR change which results agree. Only the same commit leaves out packages BBS and R Universe built from different commits, in the results bar and the table. Only different results shows only packages whose results differ. The bars follow the buttons too.
  • Status: R Universe’s overall result for the package: success or failure.
  • Source build: R Universe R CMD build of the source package, which builds vignettes.
  • Binary check: R CMD check associated with the binary.
